productOnPage.title: The Extraordinary Lives Audio
productOnPage.author: Various
productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: A collection of incredible and uplifting biographies to inspire the next generation to be extraordinary, too! Extraordinary Lives is a bold, inclusive biography series shining a light on modern and historical figures. Entertaining, accessible and educational, they are the perfect introductions to these amazing people and their achievements. This collection includes: The Extraordinary Life of Rosa Parks The Extraordinary Life of Katherine Johnson The Extraordinary Life of Michelle Obama The Extraordinary Life of Mary Seacole The Extraordinary Life of Serena Williams The Extraordinary Life of Nelson MandelaIllustrated by Ashley Evans, Sarah Walsh, Alleanna Harris, Maggie Cole and Nan Lawson. Tracks included: Who Was Rosa Parks? Rosa Growing Up Growing Up Rosa and Raymond Rosa's Boycotts Fighting For Rights Change Is Coming After The Boycott Continuing To Fight Her Last Days Her Legacy Timeline Credits

productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: A collection of incredible and uplifting biographies to inspire the next generation to be extraordinary, too!._**

Extraordinary Lives is a bold, inclusive biography series shining a light on modern and historical figures. Entertaining, accessible and educational, they are the perfect introductions to these amazing people and their achievements.   
  
  
  
  
This collection includes:   
  
  
  
  
The Extraordinary Life of Rosa Parks   
  
The Extraordinary Life of Katherine Johnson   
  
The Extraordinary Life of Michelle Obama   
  
The Extraordinary Life of Mary Seacole   
  
The Extraordinary Life of Serena Williams   
  
The Extraordinary Life of Nelson Mandela  
  
  
  
  
Illustrated by Ashley Evans, Sarah Walsh, Alleanna Harris, Maggie Cole and Nan Lawson.

Tracks included:

*   Who Was Rosa Parks?
*   Rosa Growing Up
*   Growing Up
*   Rosa and Raymond
*   Rosa's Boycotts
*   Fighting For Rights
*   Change Is Coming
*   After The Boycott
*   Continuing To Fight
*   Her Last Days
*   Her Legacy
*   Timeline
*   Credits

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
